QUESTION:
What was the default value of `retention.log_level` in PaderQueue 3.x?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0469] config | retention.log_level (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `retention.log_level` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `warn` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | retention |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.log_level` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
log_level = "warn"
```

---

[d0369] config | retention.log_level | version 4.x
# `retention.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `error` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | retention |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `retention.log_level` only if you observe problems with the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
log_level = "error"
```

# `compactor.log_level` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `info` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | compactor |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.log_level` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
log_level = "info"
```
